‘‘I don’t want to see animals dying because of the drought.

The existence of the farm is a significant boost to farmers who will be equipped with distinct skills in the use of technology like pasture preservation and prevent the losses caused by drought due to poor methods of grazing.

title: Tana River celebrates world food day

shortage.quote: Close to 150,000 people in Tana River cannot afford food as drought continues to bite according to Governor Godhana.
